About Wingman Bahrain

Wingman Bahrain is a fast‑casual restaurant brand dedicated to delivering bold, flavour‑packed chicken wings made with high‑quality ingredients.

Our journey started with a passion for great food and a vision to create a brand that combines quality, consistency, and convenience.

Every wing is cooked to order using carefully selected ingredients and precise preparation techniques.

Our Journey

2019

The idea of Wingman Bahrain was born.

2021

Expanded menu with signature sauces and new flavours.

2023

Opened multiple branches and improved online ordering.

Today

Serving wing lovers across Bahrain every week.

Our Brand Promise

At Wingman Bahrain, we promise fresh, flavour‑packed wings prepared with care and delivered with speed. We are committed to quality, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Community & Responsibility

We proudly support local suppliers and initiatives, believing that strong communities build strong brands. Responsible sourcing and local collaboration are part of our identity.

Looking Ahead
